nodes.name: Read Raw Data
nodes.notes: Pulls the full current dataset as JSON rows.

parameters.pythonCode:
# Light pre-clean in n8n's built-in Python (Pyodide) sandbox.
# Pyodide here only has the Python standard library available (no pip installs,
# no pandas, no network) -- the heavy cleaning/dedup happens in the FastAPI
# backend, which has full pandas. This step just trims and drops obviously
# empty rows before sending the batch onward.

cleaned = []
for item in items:
    row = dict(item['json'])
    for key, value in row.items():
        if isinstance(value, str):
            row[key] = value.strip()
    has_content = any(v not in ('', None) for v in row.values())
    if has_content:
        cleaned.append({'json': row})

return cleaned

nodes.name: Python Pre-clean
nodes.notes: n8n Code node set to Python mode. Trims strings and drops fully-empty rows before the backend call.

nodes.name: Send to Python Backend
nodes.notes: Calls the FastAPI backend's /api/ingest endpoint. It cleans with pandas, dedupes, stores in SQLite, and returns the cleaned rows. Replace localhost:8000 with your deployed backend URL if hosted remotely.

nodes.name: Mirror to Dashboard Data Sheet
nodes.notes: Optional: writes the backend's cleaned_rows back into the Dashboard Data tab, so you still have a human-readable copy in Sheets. The live dashboard itself reads from the backend API, not this sheet.
